rows.note: Use this when the person visibly looks sullen or unapproachable while doing something.

example.english: They washed the dishes glumly, making me afraid to speak to them.
example.traditional: 佢黑口黑面咁洗碗，搞到我都唔敢同佢講嘢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hak1 hau2 haak1 min6 gam3 sai2 wun2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 m4 gam2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 je5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in a glum or unhappy manner.

example.english: I went home glumly after hearing the news.
example.traditional: 聽完呢個消息，我悶悶不樂咁返咗屋企。
example.jyutping: teng1 jyun4 nei1 go3 siu1 sik1 ngo5 mun6 mun6 bat1 lok6 gam3 faan2 zo2 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this when the glumness includes feeling dejected or discouraged, especially after a setback.

example.english: They left the field glumly after losing the match.
example.traditional: 輸咗場波之後，佢垂頭喪氣咁走出球場。
example.jyutping: syu1 zo2 coeng4 bo1 zi1 hau6 keoi5 seoi4 tau4 song3 hei3 gam3 zau2 ceot1 kau4 coeng4
